Bug_Title: "ThreadLocal" variables should be cleaned up when no longer used
Bug_Explanation: The code incorrectly uses set(null) to clear the ThreadLocal variable instead of remove(), which can lead to memory leaks.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug method, which demonstrates the incorrect use of set(null) instead of remove() on a ThreadLocal variable. This leads to an UnauthorizedException being thrown when get() is called, triggering the bug.
